presentation.name: Launch & Growth
presentation.description: Executes the permitted acquisition path after the launch gate. Not active in this production-floor preview.

excerpts.inputs: **Upstream → Inputs:** `MarketBrief` + `ProductPackage` + `Blueprint.market_signal` (VOC, hooks, persona).
excerpts.outputs: **Outputs → Downstream:** `LaunchKit` + `SignalResult{scale|fix|kill}` → Orchestrator + Outcomes Analyst.
excerpts.quality_metrics: **Quality Metrics:** cold-conversion on the ask · day-2/3/7 retention · signal clarity (unambiguous verdict).
excerpts.definition_of_done: **Definition of Done:** a fireable launch kit + a signal test whose result is an unambiguous scale/fix/kill, judged against a bar committed BEFORE launch.
excerpts.failure_conditions: **Failure Conditions:** >1 ask per post · success bar set/changed AFTER results · counting warm-circle/likes as signal · launching in all rooms at once (attention sprawl).
excerpts.machine_interface:
**Machine interface:**
- `input_artifact_refs[]`: `[MarketBrief, ProductPackage @Worker 09, Blueprint.market_signal @Worker 02 (VOC, hooks, persona), SuccessBar (frozen policy artifact), LaunchApproval (founder artifact — the reserved launch_commit gate)]`
- `output_artifact_ref`: `LaunchKit{landing,listing,post_variants[],pricing}` + `SignalResult{room,ask,bar,result,verdict:scale|fix|kill,evidence[]}` (`.json`, versioned + hashed)
- `schema_ref`: `schemas/launch-kit.schema.json` + `schemas/signal-result.schema.json` (owned by Schema Steward / Worker 13; validated by Artifact Validator / Worker 14)
- `validator_required`: `true` — the frozen `SuccessBar` and the founder `LaunchApproval` artifacts must both validate present BEFORE go-live; `SignalResult` is schema-validated before handoff to the Outcomes Analyst (11)
- `source_ref_policy`: post variants quote verbatim VOC traced to `Blueprint.market_signal` (`source_ref` per hook); the `bar` field references the frozen `SuccessBar` artifact ID — the success bar may never be set or changed after results exist
- `dynamic_fact_policy`: the `SuccessBar` is frozen (immutable) at commit time and the read window is fixed; post-result bar edits are forbidden (a changed-after-results bar is a self-deception failure, not a refresh)
- `failure_route`: missing/absent `LaunchApproval` at go-live → `external_review_required` (block — wait for the founder `LaunchApproval` artifact, never a live ping); a stale/defective `ProductPackage` → `route_to_upstream_worker` (Publisher 09); ambiguous/unreadable signal → `park_probe`; a clear cold NO → `kill_probe` (verdict carried to 11)
- `retry_policy`: `max_retries: 2` on launch-mechanics faults (page/funnel/event-capture failure) only; the binary signal read itself is NOT retried to chase a better number — one room, one pre-committed bar, one honest verdict
- `artifact_hash`: SHA-256 over the canonicalized `LaunchKit` + `SignalResult`; binds the verdict to the exact `SuccessBar` + `ProductPackage` versions it was judged against
- `telemetry_emitted[]`: `launch.started · launch.success_bar_frozen{ref} · launch.approval_received{LaunchApproval} · launch.shipped_to_room · launch.signal_captured · launch.verdict{scale|fix|kill}`

**Autonomy Contract:**
```
autonomy_level: external_artifact_required
allowed_terminal_states: [auto_pass, auto_fail, retry, route_back, quarantine, park_probe, kill_probe, publish_blocked, capability_request, verification_debt, external_review_required]
forbidden_routes: [ask_founder, wait_for_manual_decision, optional_human_signoff, founder_championed_exception]
default_on_ambiguity: park_probe
max_retries: 2
escalation_artifact: ExternalReviewRequest
```
*(Reserved founder gate **launch_commit**: this worker freezes a policy `SuccessBar`, then BLOCKS on the founder's `LaunchApproval` artifact before go-live — an artifact-blocking gate, never a live ping. Reading the result against the pre-committed bar and emitting `scale|fix|kill` is fully autonomous.)*

presentation.name: Outcomes Analyst
presentation.description: Analyzes measured outcomes after launch; it does not infer sales from published assets.

excerpts.inputs: **Upstream → Inputs:** `SignalResult` + live app telemetry (pass-reported, retention events, churn) + revenue.
excerpts.outputs: **Outputs → Downstream:** `OutcomeReport` → SME/Curriculum (content fixes) + Market Scout (re-rank portfolio) + Orchestrator (dashboard).
excerpts.quality_metrics: **Quality Metrics:** improvement uplift cycle-over-cycle · forecast accuracy (modeled vs realized) · % fixes that raise retention/pass.
excerpts.definition_of_done: **Definition of Done:** every live probe has a current OutcomeReport with at least one concrete content fix or a re-rank decision; retention + reported-pass are tracked, not signups.
excerpts.failure_conditions: **Failure Conditions:** vanity metrics (likes/installs) treated as outcomes · no actionable fix produced · ignoring churn signal.
excerpts.machine_interface:
**Machine interface:**
- `input_artifact_refs[]`: `[SignalResult @Worker 10, live app telemetry (pass-reported, retention events, churn), revenue]`
- `output_artifact_ref`: `OutcomeReport` (`{probe, retention[d2,d3,d7,d30], reported_pass_rate, churn_points[], content_fixes[], portfolio_rerank[], revenue}`, `.json`, versioned + hashed)
- `schema_ref`: `schemas/outcome-report.schema.json` (owned by Schema Steward / Worker 13; validated by Artifact Validator / Worker 14)
- `validator_required`: `true` — `OutcomeReport` is schema-validated before it routes content fixes back to SME/Curriculum or a re-rank to the Market Scout
- `source_ref_policy`: every fix/re-rank traces to a measured cohort metric (retention curve, reported pass-rate, churn point) — no vanity metric (likes/installs) treated as an outcome; the realized-vs-modeled comparison cites the original estimate it updates
- `dynamic_fact_policy`: realized metrics are the dynamic input — each `OutcomeReport` is re-cut per cycle from fresh telemetry (the compounding flywheel); a fix that depends on a stale cohort is reissued, not frozen
- `failure_route`: a weak/confusing deck correlated with churn → `route_to_upstream_worker` (content fix to SME/Curriculum); a realized signal that overturns the modeled rank → `route_to_upstream_worker` (re-rank to Market Scout); insufficient telemetry to produce an actionable fix → `park_probe`; a probe whose realized signal is a clear failure → `kill_probe`
- `retry_policy`: `max_retries: 2` re-analysis passes on a data-pull/computation fault; a probe with persistently insufficient signal is parked, not retried indefinitely
- `artifact_hash`: SHA-256 over the canonicalized `OutcomeReport`, pinned to the telemetry window analyzed; blocks acting on a stale cycle's outcomes
- `telemetry_emitted[]`: `outcomes.started · outcomes.cohorts_pulled · outcomes.diagnosis_done · outcomes.content_fixes{count} · outcomes.portfolio_reranked · outcomes.emitted{hash}`

```
allowed_terminal_states: [auto_pass, auto_fail, retry, route_back, quarantine, park_probe, kill_probe, publish_blocked, capability_request, verification_debt, external_review_required]
forbidden_routes: [ask_founder, wait_for_manual_decision, optional_human_signoff, founder_championed_exception]

```

presentation.name: Artifact Validator
presentation.description: Runs after each artifact. Structural validation is necessary and does not itself certify factual truth.

excerpts.inputs:
**Upstream → Inputs:**
- **any emitted artifact** — the freshly produced output of **any worker (00–24)** before it hands off: `MarketBrief` (01), `CompetitiveIntel` (01b), `Blueprint` (02), `KnowledgeGraph` (03/kg-dept), `CardDeck` (04), `VoiceScripts` (05), `ExamBank` (06), `UISpec` (UI Architect), `CoverageReport` (07), `FactReport` (08), `ProductPackage` (09), `LaunchKit`/`SignalResult` (10), `OutcomeReport` (11), `FactoryManifest`/`ProbeRegistry` (12), `SourceRegistry` (15), plus roadmap artifacts (`EnrichedBlueprint`, `AudioAssetManifest`, `DynamicFactSet`, `LearningModel`, `RuntimeBundle`, `PortfolioDecision`, etc.).
- `SchemaRegistry` (**Schema Steward, 13**) — the versioned `schema_ref` set + compatibility matrix to validate against.
excerpts.outputs:
**Outputs → Downstream:**
- `ValidationReport` (`verdict:PASS|FAIL` + typed errors + route-back) → **Orchestrator (00)** consumes it as the handoff gate: on `PASS` the Orchestrator advances the artifact to its next worker; on `FAIL` the Orchestrator routes the artifact back to its producer with this report's error list. The Validator does not itself dispatch — it gates; the Orchestrator routes.
excerpts.quality_metrics: **Quality Metrics:** zero invalid artifacts advanced downstream (fail-closed integrity) · 100% of FAILs carry a `route_back.to_worker` + actionable reason · escaped-defect rate (malformed artifact that passed and broke a later stage → target 0) · false-positive rate (valid artifact wrongly blocked → target 0) · provenance-gap catch-rate (missing `source_ref` caught here, 100%) · **contract-lint catch-rate** (any active contract that is skeleton/machine-interface-incomplete, missing `schema_ref`/`failure_route`/`retry_policy`, carries a forbidden route, has an unsafe publish path, or is stale-unmarked → caught here, 100%).
excerpts.definition_of_done: **Definition of Done:** every emitted artifact validated against its registered schema before handoff; **invalid artifacts cannot move downstream** (PASS is required to advance); gate failures are typed (error class + json_path + expected/actual) and actionable (named producer + fix reason); **every active contract is CONTRACT-LINTED** — skeleton + machine interface complete, `schema_ref`/`failure_route`/`retry_policy` present, no forbidden route, no publish path reachable without `FactReport`+`CoverageReport`+`SourceRegistry`, and any stale doc carries `superseded_by`/`canonicality: historical_reference_only`; the Orchestrator (00) receives the exact blocker reason; report hashed and emitted.
excerpts.failure_conditions: **Failure Conditions:** passing an artifact that violates its schema (fail-open) · a FAIL with no named producer to route back to or a non-actionable reason · validating against a stale/wrong schema version · missing a dangling reference or a missing `source_ref` · letting a hash-mismatched (stale) artifact through · blocking a genuinely-valid artifact (false positive that jams the line) · **passing an active contract that is missing the 13-field skeleton or 10-field machine interface, lacks `schema_ref`/`failure_route`/`retry_policy`, contains a forbidden route, has a publish path reachable without `FactReport`+`CoverageReport`+`SourceRegistry`, or is a stale doc lacking `superseded_by`/`canonicality: historical_reference_only`.**
excerpts.machine_interface: **Machine interface:** `input_artifact_refs:[<any emitted artifact>, SchemaRegistry] · output_artifact_ref:ValidationReport · schema_ref:schemas/validation_report.schema.json@v1 (from Schema Steward 13) · validator_required:true (self-validating — its own report is schema-checked) · source_ref_policy:"ENFORCES the policy — fails any fact-bearing artifact whose facts lack a resolvable source_ref" · dynamic_fact_policy:"validates that DynamicFactSet entries carry freshness/expiry fields per schema; does not itself refresh facts" · failure_route:Orchestrator(00) (which then routes the artifact back to its named producer) · retry_policy:0 (validation is deterministic — a FAIL is a real FAIL, not retried; the producer fixes and re-submits) · artifact_hash:sha256(report) · telemetry_emitted:[artifact_validated, validation_passed, validation_failed, error_class_counts, stale_artifact_blocked]`
excerpts.autonomy: **Autonomy Contract:** `autonomy_level: autonomous` — a fully deterministic gate that **never** routes to the founder. Surfaces verdicts + error-class telemetry to the Orchestrator as observability; a repeated FAIL on the same artifact after route-back is emitted as a `stuck_line` signal (→ `park_probe` / `capability_request`), but the Validator never waves an artifact through. `allowed_terminal_states: [auto_pass, auto_fail, route_back, park_probe, capability_request]` · `forbidden_routes: [ask_founder, optional_human_signoff, human_owner_approval, wait_for_manual_decision]` · `default_on_ambiguity: auto_fail` · `max_retries: 0` (deterministic).

presentation.name: Evidence Librarian
presentation.input: Pinned source locators and evidence policy
presentation.description: Maintains independent source evidence and stable references. The verification fetch door does not invent new authorities.

excerpts.inputs:
**Upstream → Inputs:**
- **source citations** — the raw source list the **SME Research Agent (02)** gathers while building a probe's `Blueprint` (issuing-body pages, official handbooks, regulation text, standards docs, the published item bank) — names + locators + the fact each is meant to anchor.
excerpts.outputs:
**Outputs → Downstream:**
- `SourceRegistry` (the typed, dated, trust-rated source ledger with stable `source_ref` IDs) → **SME Research Agent (02)** stamps each `Blueprint` fact's `source_ref` from it; → **Hallucination Auditor (08)** resolves each claim's `source_ref` against the registered source (+ snapshot) to verify truth; → **Dynamic Facts Monitor (18)** reads each source's `refresh_policy`/`last_retrieved` to know what to re-pull and when.
excerpts.quality_metrics: **Quality Metrics:** source coverage (every Blueprint fact resolves to a registered `source_ref` — 100%) · official-source share (target: high-risk facts 100% on `official_body`/`regulator_standard`) · dating completeness (every source has `retrieved_at` + `refresh` policy — 100%) · snapshot integrity (cited content frozen + hashed) · high-risk-gate enforcement (zero high-risk facts anchored to low-trust sources).
excerpts.definition_of_done: **Definition of Done:** every fact points to a registered source; every source carries a retrieval date + a refresh policy; official sources are preferred (highest available tier per fact); **low-trust sources cannot anchor high-risk clinical/legal/safety facts** (gate enforced, rejections recorded); registry validated, snapshotted, hashed, version-bumped, and published for 02/08/18.
excerpts.failure_conditions: **Failure Conditions:** a fact with no registered source · a source with no retrieval date or no refresh policy · a high-risk (clinical/legal/safety) fact anchored to a `secondary`/`user_generated` source · preferring a low tier when an official source exists · an un-snapshotted source (so a later edit silently invalidates a fact) · a fragile URL used as the ref instead of a stable `source_ref` ID · an un-hashed/un-versioned registry.
excerpts.machine_interface: **Machine interface:** `input_artifact_refs:[<SME source citations from Blueprint, worker 02>] · output_artifact_ref:SourceRegistry · schema_ref:schemas/source_registry.schema.json@v1 (from Schema Steward 13) · validator_required:true · source_ref_policy:"OWNS the policy — mints the stable source_ref every other worker uses; a fact with no registered source cannot be anchored, and trust tier governs which facts a source may anchor" · dynamic_fact_policy:"assigns each source a refresh_cadence + expires_or_review_by that the Dynamic Facts Monitor (18) consumes; marks sources stale on expiry" · failure_route:Orchestrator(00) · retry_policy:1 · artifact_hash:sha256(registry) · telemetry_emitted:[source_registered, source_snapshotted, low_trust_rejected_high_risk, source_marked_stale, refresh_due]`

```yaml
allowed_terminal_states: [auto_pass, route_back, retry, verification_debt, publish_blocked, external_review_required, quarantine]
```

excerpts.quality_metrics: **Quality Metrics:** completeness = review intervals + readiness score + high-yield weighting ALL defined (no placeholder) · tunability = the model accepts an `OutcomeReport` and produces a logged, bounded adjustment · predictive validity (post-tuning) = readiness score correlates with realized pass (improving cycle-over-cycle) · retention fit = modeled forgetting tracks observed per-concept forget rates · signal preservation = `exam_weight`/`high_yield` carried through unchanged (weighting added, not overwritten) · overfit guard = every tuning step is bounded + evidence-referenced.
